title: Revisiting Dwork cohomology: visibility and divisibility of Frobenius eigenvalues in rigid cohomology: exactness of the rows of the Dwork double complex (Lemma 6.7)
author: Daqing Wan and Dingxin Zhang
work: Revisiting Dwork cohomology: Visibility and divisibility of Frobenius eigenvalues in rigid cohomology
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the exactness of the rows of the article's Dwork double complex, printed as Lemma 6.7 (source0.tex lines 2570--2574, source label lemma:c-exactness-of-rows), delivered with the article's own complete proof at source0.tex lines 2576--2710 (135 lines). The statement is a chain-level assertion about the double complex (6.5) built from the overconvergent Dwork complex: each of its rows is exact in cohomology degrees 0,1,...,c-1, which is what makes the 0th to (c-1)st columns of the E_1-page of the associated spectral sequence vanish. The proof is a genuine source-local argument rather than a citation: it first replaces the toric double complex by an equivalent affine complex with differentials D_j, reduces exactness of every row to acyclicity of the zeroth row of a smaller double complex, then builds an auxiliary Dwork crystal on a product of formal projective spaces, applies the Baldassarri--Berthelot local comparison theorem, uses the retained Lemma 5.6 to concentrate the local cohomology complex in degree 0, and finally identifies the shifted zeroth row with a relative de Rham complex, which is the claimed acyclicity. The two quoted inputs (the comparison theorem, and the equivalence between overconvergent D-modules and modules over the overconvergent Weyl algebra) are named and retained in the item as statements, and the proof, not the quotation, is the work: this lemma is the technical heart of the paper's Dwork-cohomology method, on which the paper's divisibility theorems rest. H2: an original research lemma with a complete author proof, depending on two quoted external theorems.
